editorial:
Imagine traveling to a quiet valley in Norway where a dark secret has been hiding for hundreds of years. You follow Laura, a young theater director who brings a group of famous actors to this remote spot to put on a show. The vibe starts off calm, but you quickly realize the land is cursed. Long ago, a girl was wrongly accused of being a witch and thrown into a deep pit. Now, that old anger has come back to haunt the living. Once the lead actor vanishes into thin air, the whole trip turns into a nightmare where the group has to figure out how to survive a grudge from the past.

What really works here is how the movie builds tension using the creepy scenery. The acting is solid, and the way the mystery unfolds keeps you guessing until the end. It does have some slow parts, but the scary payoffs make it worth the wait. If you enjoy folk horror and spooky legends, you will love this. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the reveal that the spirit of the murdered girl is seeking revenge on anyone who enters the valley. After the actors face several scares, it becomes clear that the cycle of violence won't stop until the truth is acknowledged. The survivors barely escape the valley, but the ending suggests that the evil in the pits is not fully gone, leaving the door open for the curse to strike again if people keep digging into the past.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves ghost stories and creepy old legends.
